title: Agent Frontdoor v0.1
description: Pre-flight contract for AI agent task dispatch. Validates task classification, risk assessment, authority requirements, and worker assignment before any agent action is taken.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier. Recommended format: YYYYMMDD_slug

input_summary.description: Short summary of the task request (max 500 chars)

task_class.description: Task classification. Determines routing and gate requirements.

risk_tags.description: Risk signals that affect routing and gate requirements. Multiple tags may apply.

predicted_confidence.description: Confidence in task_class and predicted_worker assignment

allowed_actions.description: Explicit list of actions the worker is permitted to take

forbidden_actions.description: Explicit list of actions the worker must not take

required_evidence.description: Evidence items that must be present before the task can proceed

required_manifest.description: Type of manifest required before execution

human_gate.description: Human approval requirement. 'blocking' means the task cannot proceed without explicit human sign-off.

actual_worker.description: Actual worker(s) used after dispatch. Null if not yet dispatched.

substitution_reason.description: Reason if actual_worker differs from predicted_worker

routing_deviation.description: True if actual_worker differs from predicted_worker

boundary_drift.description: True if the worker exceeded the allowed_actions boundary

boundary_drift_reason.description: Description of boundary drift if it occurred

assumptions.description: Assumptions made during classification that require verification

next_safe_step.description: Recommended next action given current task state
